findings.title: assets/app.css contains the literal prefers-color-scheme in a comment
findings.detail: assets/app.css line 2 (header comment) contains the words 'prefers-color-scheme'. There is no such rule (tests/css.test.js strips comments before asserting, so the test is green), but the literal spot-check 'no prefers-color-scheme in assets/app.css' and any grep of the file yield a false positive. Fix: reword the comment without the literal (e.g. 'no colour-scheme media query anywhere in this file'). No behaviour change.
findings.proof: Select-String -Path assets/app.css -Pattern 'prefers-color-scheme' returns 0 matches; npm test (tests/css.test.js) stays green.

findings.title: Recorded post-fix build byte count does not match the committed tree
findings.detail: The fix/review-loop row in .agents/tasks/site-build/status.md and the 197f8f0 commit body record the after-fix build as 'bytes 1376900'; building HEAD d81163f prints 'pages 28 · h3 89 · chips 127 · crossrefs 113 rewritten / 5 skipped · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 · search 965 records · bytes 1377293' on two consecutive runs (deterministic; the recorded number predates the fixer's last CSS edit). Evidence precision only: the full --all verify on HEAD passed 5830 checks with 0 failures. Fix: correct the status.md number to the HEAD build line and quote the shipped tree's build summary in the ship report.
findings.proof: npm run build on the shipped HEAD prints the summary line and status.md quotes the same bytes value.
